technology_name: A MAGNETORHEOLOGICAL FLUID-BASED BRAKING SYSTEM FOR TWO WHEELERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Automotive Braking / MR Fluid Actuator
problem_solved: Conventional mechanical friction disc brakes suffer from high pad wear, thermal fading under sustained load, and display slow electronic integration responses during anti-lock braking events.
description: An innovative automotive braking assembly comprising a dual-lip wheel-hub housing packed with an active magnetorheological (MR) fluid, wrapped circumferentially with an electromagnetic coil winding managed by a bobbin assembly.
applications: High-performance electric motorcycle braking arrays, automated automated guided vehicle (AGV) decelerators, micro-mobility safety components, and smart industrial brake systems.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
